Resorts.ParkingAreasDescription: Free parking is only available in the main lots of the Snow Park base area this summer. We kindly ask you to follow all signage and directions given by our staff members. Additionally, all three day lodge locations are serviced by Park City's complimentary transit system. This transit system runs frequently throughout the greater Park City area and within the Deer Valley Resort area.
